sentences.text: On 1.31, you add a new ServiceCIDR object with the desired CIDR (e.g., 10.96.0.0/24) to extend the Service IP range.

citations.quote:
cat <EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: ServiceCIDR
metadata:
  name: newcidr1
spec:
  cidrs:
  - 10.96.0.0/24

gaps: The 1.27 documentation excerpts do not cover this.
